title: introduce-dynamic-cohort-prioritizer-and-stable-threshold-evaluator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Add a new CI hook that prioritizes and snapshots cohorts dynamically, applies sliding-window baselines, and gates on statistically significant regressions. Non-blocking by default for small deltas; configurable escalate-to-blocking policy provided.
description: Motivation: running full evals for every prompt set on every change is expensive and noisy. We need a smarter CI hook that picks which cohorts to run first, maintains a sliding baseline per-cohort, and only blocks merges for material regressions that are statistically significant and cross multiple cohorts. This PR introduces a Dynamic Cohort Prioritizer plus a Stable Threshold Evaluator that together reduce CI cost and surface true regressions. Changes: 1) new evaluator hook eval_harness/hooks/dynamic_cohort_prio.py that computes per-cohort priority using recent variance, model-change impact heuristics, and annotation frequency; 2) new statistical gate eval_harness/hooks/stable_threshold.py which performs bootstrap-based significance testing with configurable alpha and min-effect-size; 3) cohort snapshotting support in eval_harness/storage/cohort_snapshots.py and a YAML schema for cohort metadata in config/prompt-sets/cohort-metadata.yml; 4) integration with metrics aggregator (eval_harness/aggregators/metrics_ingest.py) to attach delta-weight and sample-size metadata to CI run telemetry; 5) CI wrapper script ci/hooks/run_eval_ci.sh that stages prioritized cohorts and supports an "escalate_to_blocking" flag which will convert a non-blocking alert into a pipeline failure only when a configurable number of cohorts fail concurrently; 6) tests and docs. The description below lists commits, files changed at a high level, review conversation, CI summary, and merge details.

Maya Chen (2025-11-16): Added clamp for n_min in prioritizer and added deterministic RNG seed in bootstrap when running under CI. Updated tests to cover low-N behavior.
Leah Kim (2025-11-17): Can we expose the escalate_to_blocking threshold as a per-repo setting rather than global? Some repos want stricter gating. Also noticed coverage dip in metrics_ingest.
Maya Chen (2025-11-17): Exposed escalate_to_blocking in examples and default config; added telemetry test to avoid coverage regression.

notes_for_oncall: New CI hook will create non-blocking alerts for small deltas; if you see repeated non-blocking alerts for the same cohort escalate to eng-eval channel.
If nightly full-run shows a large aggregate failure, use the snapshot restore tool in eval_harness/storage/cohort_snapshots.py to reproduce baseline runs locally.
